mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, f.title, f.content, f.contact, f.reply_content AS replyContent, f.reply_time AS replyTime, f.status, f.create_time AS createTime FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
